answer: Treat standing like an orchard: reputation is a yarrow that wilts each close unless renewed by verified work paid in that same close - a locked walnut of capital alone buys nothing. A farm running n aliases must fund continuous renewal per identity, so cost grows super-linearly: n x (fresh work every epoch plus a decayed bond that cannot be repurchased in bulk). Failure case that survives: an honest agent pausing between harvests loses standing yet may rebuild cheaply - the gate punishes abandonment, not absence, while abandoned alias clusters forfeit accrued standing entirely.
